name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
title: The hard-stop pull-up
build_note: Listed 6-6, 195 lb (Basketball-Reference); 6-11 1/2 wingspan measured at the 2018 draft combine (A Sea of Blue, as cited in the Nov 15 recap). His look in kit/looks.json is only proposed, so he is drawn with the house default skin tone and dark hair until the owner approves one.
steps: One hard stop. The defender keeps going.
Up into the gap before he recovers.
aria: Animated illustration of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's hard-stop pull-up: he drives at full speed so his defender backpedals, stops on a dime with his lead foot planted out in front, the defender keeps sliding back and a gap opens, and he rises into it for a mid-range pull-up jumper. Afterimages pile up as he stops and skid marks show the plant. An original drawing, not traced from footage, not to scale.
